title: A led work order that is Complete is not counted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, who holds nothing except the work named below.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Complete, led by staff member A, with a line holding a labor entry for staff member A, so the person holds only work that is closed.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Technician off.
  3. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Staff Member window opens with Technician on.

Step 2:

  • The Technician toggle is off.

Step 3:

  • No warning window shows and the save goes straight on.
  • The window closes.
  • Staff member A's row shows "No" in the Technician column (the save ran).

The work order or line named in the preconditions is the only thing staff member A holds, and it must not be counted. Work order 1 stays as it is.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off)

  • S2-E1: “Declined, Complete, Invoiced and Paid work orders, part sales, and declined lines on any work order are never counted.”
  • S2-N1: “If no open work order or line is counted, no warning shows and the save goes straight on.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "4 Turn Technician off with open work", picture "Turn Off Technician warning" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p4-02-after-turn-off-technician-warning.png

The design's own words:

  • “Save shows this first, only when the person still leads an open work order or is on a line of one (with labor, added with Add Technician, or as the line's technician), at any location. Otherwise Save goes straight on.”
  • “Text, verbatim with this demo's counts: "Emily Madden leads 15 open work orders and is on 141 labor lines. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."”
  • “Cancel, the X or Escape leave the staff member unsaved. Save continues the save. Nothing is unassigned either way.”

No picture of a save without the warning; the design's words are the warning caption.
